programs.title: Laila
programs.desc: Story of the bitter hatred between two families, Bharat Singh's family, and Prithviraj Singh's family. Years later, Prithviraj's son Dharamraj gets married to Sunaina, who gives birth to a baby boy named Deshraj. When Prithviraj tries to settle the issues between the families, he gets poisoned by his chauffeur, Chandu, who was bribed and manipulated by Bharat and his men. On knowing this, Dharamraj poisons Chandu and sends Deshraj to the U.S. to continue his studies in a safer atmosphere. Years later, Deshraj returns home and ens up falling for a young woman named Leela, who is none other than Chandu's daughter. Fearing for his son's life, Dharamraj puts forward a proposal to Bharat. What could the proposal be?

programs.title: The Legend of Bhagat Singh
programs.desc: During the British Raj, upon witnessing the atrocities of the British, Bhagat Singh grows up to be a fierce freedom fighter. His publicised ideas of revolution bring him to as much popularity as Mahatma Gandhi amongst Indians.
